title: Check and top up the coolant
summary: Read the reservoir level and top up with the right coolant before a low level turns into overheating.
parts: Pre-mixed coolant (type on your spec sheet)

steps.text: Check with the engine cold and the bike upright on level ground.
steps.caution: Never open the radiator cap on a hot engine. Pressurized coolant can spray out and scald you.

steps.text: Find the coolant reservoir. On most scooters it sits behind a small cover on the floorboard or under the front panel.
Read the level against the LOWER and UPPER marks on the tank.
If it is below LOWER, remove the reservoir cap and add pre-mixed coolant up to UPPER. Don't fill past it.
Refit the cap and cover, then wipe off any spills.
steps.caution: Coolant is sweet and toxic to pets and children. Clean spills right away.

steps.text: If you have to top up more than once a month, look for leaks at the hoses, radiator and water pump, or have a shop pressure-test the system.
